subject: Public Comments Form
comment:
We have a lateral sewer line that has a 'belly' or sink in it so it over time sewage has now backed up into the house twice and we just moved in 10/31/2025.

We just built our home and had no idea this is a problem that could have occurred anytime over the last 30 years.

The home is on south Foremaster ridge, lot 59. It was first developed in 1995-1996 by R and D Development, Greg Rogers (this information was gathered by a city engineer, Cathy (Hasburger- I believe). To our knowledge no one has checked the line since he put it in.

Upon our findings by our builders' plumber, Chris with Drainmasters, and then confirmation by the city, a belly has a some point occurred in the line under the city street right next to the sewer main.

No one will take responsibility for it and it is now been put on us. But with the decades of construction and repair on the street something happened prior to our build and we would like financial assistance with this or repair by the city as it is in public street.
